questions.question: Which description best identifies Wurtz reaction?

options.A: an acyclic hydrocarbon containing a carbon-carbon double bond
options.B: coupling of alkyl halides with sodium in dry ether
options.C: in addition of HX to an unsymmetrical alkene, H usually adds to the carbon already bearing more hydrogens
options.D: HBr adds anti-Markovnikov to an unsymmetrical alkene in the presence of peroxide

questions.question: A neutral acyclic primary monoamine contains 3 carbons and exactly one C=C bond, with no other unsaturation or heteroatom. Complete Dumas analysis of 0.6 g converts all its nitrogen into N₂. Find the N₂ mass. C=12, H=1, N=14. Choose the closest listed value.
Which description best identifies Henry law?

options.A: gas solubility in a liquid is proportional to gas partial pressure at constant temperature
options.B: a solution with zero enthalpy and zero volume change on mixing
options.C: partial vapour pressure of a volatile component equals its mole fraction times pure-component vapour pressure
options.D: vapour pressure exceeds the ideal value

questions.question: The statement ‘anode is written on the left and cathode on the right by convention’ refers to

A 100.0 mL aqueous solution has density 1.06 g mL⁻¹ and contains 4.296 g total nonvolatile nonelectrolytes A and B. Their molar masses are 60 and 180 g mol⁻¹ respectively. The total analytical molality (moles A plus moles B per kilogram water) is 0.40509714 mol kg⁻¹. What percentage of combined solute mass is A? Choose the closest listed value.

Starting with 0.01 mol substrate, ethyl ethanoate is completely hydrolysed; the alcohol fraction is isolated and oxidised completely with excess acidified dichromate. The stated target product is recovered in 75% overall molar yield relative to its stoichiometric maximum. Find the mass of ethanoic acid. Use C=12, H=1, N=14, O=16, Cl=35.5 as needed. Choose the closest listed value.

Starting with 0.016 mol substrate, 1-bromopropane is hydrolysed with aqueous alkali; the isolated alcohol is completely oxidised with excess acidified dichromate. The stated target product is recovered in 79% overall molar yield relative to its stoichiometric maximum. Find the mass of propanoic acid. Use C=12, H=1, N=14, O=16, Cl=35.5 as needed. Choose the closest listed value.
Which description best identifies haloarene?

options.A: a dihalide with halogens on adjacent carbons
options.B: a compound with halogen directly bonded to an aromatic ring
options.C: a halide with X on a carbon adjacent to a carbon-carbon double bond
options.D: a dihalide with both halogens on the same carbon

questions.question: 0.0082 mol of an octahedral cobalt(III) complex has 3 coordinated Cl⁻ ligands per Co; its other ligands are NH₃ only. Destructive analysis releases all coordinated NH₃ quantitatively. Find released NH₃ mass. N=14, H=1. Choose the closest listed value.

A pure CaCO₃ sample is partially calcined by CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s)+CO₂(g). The solid loses 1.98 g. The entire residue then consumes 0.2 mol HCl. Take molar masses CaCO₃=100, CaO=56 and CO₂=44 g mol⁻¹. What percentage of the initial carbonate decomposed? Choose the closest listed value.
Which description best identifies zero-order reaction?

options.A: a reaction whose rate is independent of reactant concentration
options.B: half-life equals ln 2 divided by k
options.C: half-life equals initial concentration divided by 2k
options.D: a reaction whose rate is proportional to one reactant concentration

questions.question: The statement ‘the 5f inner-transition series following actinium’ refers to
Anisole is heated with excess concentrated HI. Which bond cleavage and aromatic product are expected in the usual reaction?

options.A: Cleavage at the methyl–O bond; phenol
options.B: Both bonds remain intact; benzoic acid
options.D: Cleavage of the aryl–O bond by ordinary SN2; benzene

questions.question: The process alcohol → alkene + H₂O is classified as:

A solution initially contains 0.036 mol weak monoprotic acid HA. Add 0.0112 mol NaOH; both HA and A⁻ remain. With pKa=4.76, find pH using Henderson–Hasselbalch, neglecting activities and further dissociation relative to the buffer amounts. Choose the closest listed value.

20 mL of 0.01 M AgNO₃ is mixed with 10 mL of 0.0200 M NaCl. Volumes add. Before any precipitation is allowed to occur, calculate 10⁶Q, where Q=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻] with concentrations in mol L⁻¹. Choose the closest listed value.

A 10.34 g dry mixture contains only Na₂CO₃ and NaHCO₃. It consumes 0.16 mol HCl on complete conversion to NaCl, water and CO₂. Molar masses are 106 and 84 g mol⁻¹ respectively. What mass of NaHCO₃ was present? Choose the closest listed value.

In the NCERT aniline-yellow preparation, diazoaminobenzene is rearranged in aniline solvent with a small amount of aniline hydrochloride under weakly acidic conditions. Starting from 0.012 mol diazoaminobenzene, a 72% molar yield of p-aminoazobenzene is isolated. Find its mass. Both isomers have formula C₁₂H₁₁N₃; C=12, H=1, N=14. Choose the closest listed value.
At 365 K, a reaction has ΔH°=45 kJ mol⁻¹ and ΔS°=95 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹. Find ln K at this temperature. R=8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹. Choose the closest listed value.

A 0.5216 g mixture contains an acyclic monoalkene C4H8 and an acyclic monoalkyne C4H6, with no other unsaturation. Complete hydrogenation consumes 0.0147 mol H₂. Find the mole percentage of alkyne. C=12, H=1. Choose the closest listed value.

For 2SO₂(g)+O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g), use Kp=Kc(RT)^Δn with pressures in atm, concentrations in mol L⁻¹ and R=0.0821 L atm mol⁻¹ K⁻¹. At 300 K, the numerical ratio Kp/Kc is what value? Multiply the numerical value in the requested units by 10^3, then enter the nearest integer.

A 1.1003 g mixture contains only [Cr(NH₃)₆]Cl₃ and [Cr(NH₃)₅Cl]Cl₂. In a sufficiently dilute ideal solution, an independent particle-count measurement gives 0.0149 mol total solute ions. Outer-sphere ions dissociate completely and no ligand exchange occurs. Use Cr=52, NH₃=17, Cl=35.5 g mol⁻¹. Find the amount of [Cr(NH₃)₆]Cl₃. Enter the numerical value in the requested units, rounded to the nearest integer.
100.0 mL solution has density 1.09 g mL⁻¹ and contains 4.6 g urea (60 g mol⁻¹). Find its molality. Multiply the numerical value in the requested units by 10^2, then enter the nearest integer.

0.038 mol but-2-ene undergoes complete reductive ozonolysis. All carbonyl products are then treated with excess Tollens reagent. Find the mass of silver formed, assuming quantitative reactions. Ag=108 g mol⁻¹. Enter the numerical value in the requested units, rounded to the nearest integer.

A 2.52 g mixture of Mg and Al dissolves completely in excess dilute HCl, releasing 0.12 mol H₂. Assume no oxide coating or impurities. Use Mg=24 and Al=27 g mol⁻¹. What percentage of the original mass was Al? Enter the numerical value in the requested units, rounded to the nearest integer.
